def make_root(tmp_path, text=FIXTURE, dirs=("a", "a/inner", "g")):

class Recorder:
    def __init__(self, codes=None):
        self.calls = []
        self.codes = codes or {}

    def __call__(self, root, run):
        self.calls.append((run.suite.name, run.python, run.argv))
        print(f"RAN {run.label}")
        return self.codes.get(run.label, 0)


def exit_of(fn, *args, **kwargs):
    try:
        return fn(*args, **kwargs)
    except SystemExit as exc:
        return exc.code


def entry(**over):
    base = {"name": "x", "dir": "x", "with": ["pytest"]}
    base.update(over)
    return base


def git(root, *args):
    subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=root, check=True, capture_output=True)


def git_repo(root, tracked, untracked=(), gitignore=""):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    git(root, "init", "-q")
    for rel, body in tracked.items():
        p = root / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(body)
    if gitignore:
        (root / ".gitignore").write_text(gitignore)
    git(root, "add", "-A")
    for rel in untracked:
        p = root / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text("def test_u():\n    pass\n")
    return root
